events.title: Samsung Galaxy Note 9 released
events.summary: Samsung released the Samsung Galaxy Note 9 — Bluetooth S Pen and 4000 mAh battery — iterative Note update.
events.about: The Galaxy Note targeted stylus power users on [Android]. Bluetooth s pen and 4000 mah battery — iterative note update. Note apps and split-screen [Android] development often targeted this hardware class.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy Note 9 advanced Samsung's stylus phablet line.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy Note hardware defined large-screen [Android] productivity for years.
narrative.problemSolved: [Android] lacked a premium large-screen stylus flagship for note-taking workflows.
